units.source_text: 次日，匂亲王与二女公子从容睡到日上三竿，方始起身。

en.t: The next day, Prince Niou and the Second Princess slept at leisure until the sun was high, and only then rose.

units.source_text: 就在二女公子房中盥洗，吃早粥。

en.t: There in the Second Princess's room they washed and took their morning rice porridge.

units.source_text: 匂亲王在左大臣家看惯了高丽、唐土舶来的金碧辉煌的绫罗锦绣，

en.t: At the Left Minister's house, Prince Niou had grown used to dazzling silks and brocades imported from Korea and China,

units.source_text: 现在看到自邸的装饰，觉得虽是寻常世间之物，却也十分可亲。

en.t: but now, seeing the furnishings of his own residence, he felt that although they were ordinary things of this world, they were also very dear and pleasing.

units.source_text: 侍女们的服装也有穿旧了的，这环境给人沉静之感。

en.t: Some of the ladies-in-waiting wore garments that had grown old with use, and the whole setting gave a feeling of quiet calm.

units.source_text: 二女公子身穿柔软的淡紫色衫子，上罩暗红面子蓝里子的褂子。

en.t: The Second Princess wore a soft pale purple robe, with an outer garment whose face was dark red and whose lining was blue.

units.source_text: 那随意不拘的姿态，比较起六女公子的全般簇新、富丽堂皇的服饰来，

en.t: Her relaxed, unstudied manner, when compared with the Sixth Princess's wholly new and splendidly magnificent attire,

units.source_text: 并不觉得逊色。

en.t: did not seem inferior in the least.

units.source_text: 她的温柔妩媚的姿色，对匂亲王的深恩重爱受之无愧。

en.t: Her gentle and alluring beauty was fully worthy of Prince Niou's deep affection and favor.

units.source_text: 她的面庞本来丰肥圆满，近来稍稍清减，颜色越发白嫩，更显得高尚优雅了。

en.t: Her face had originally been plump and rounded, but lately she had grown a little thinner; her complexion was even fairer and more delicate, making her look still more noble and elegant.

units.source_text: 原来匂亲王以前不曾发现这种香气时，早就担心：

en.t: In fact, even before Prince Niou had noticed this fragrance, he had already been uneasy:

units.source_text: 二女公子的容貌比其他女子优越得多，设想倘有非嫡亲兄弟的男子接近她，偶有机会听到她的声音，窥见她的相貌，岂能漠然无动于衷，

en.t: the Second Princess's looks surpassed those of other women by far, and if a man who was not her own true brother came near her and happened to hear her voice or glimpse her appearance, how could he remain indifferent and unmoved?

units.source_text: 势必对她发生恋慕之情。

en.t: He would surely come to feel longing and love for her.

units.source_text: 他根据自己的好色之心如此推测，所以常常留心察看，往往装作无意的样子，查看二女公子身边的橱子和小柜子，

en.t: Judging from his own amorous nature, he reasoned in this way, and so he often kept watch, frequently pretending to be casual as he inspected the cabinets and small boxes near the Second Princess,

units.source_text: 里面有否可做证据的书信。

en.t: to see whether there were any letters inside that could serve as evidence.

units.source_text: 然而一点也找不出来，只找到些寥寥数语的寻常信件，偶然夹杂在其他物件之中。

en.t: Yet he could not find anything at all, only a few ordinary notes of a few brief words, accidentally mixed in among other things.

units.source_text: 他觉得奇怪，常常疑心两人的关系总不会如此简单。

en.t: He found this strange and often suspected that the relationship between the two of them could not possibly be so simple.

units.source_text: 所以今天发现了香气而如此猜忌，原是理之当然。

en.t: Therefore it was only natural that, having discovered the fragrance today, he became so suspicious and jealous.

units.source_text: 他想：“薰中纳言的丰采，凡是懂得风情的女子，看见了必然爱慕，哪里会坚决拒绝呢？

en.t: He thought, "With Middle Counselor Kaoru's handsome bearing, any woman who understands refinement would surely fall in love with him on sight; how could she firmly reject him?

units.source_text: 这两人才貌相当，多分是互相爱上了。”

en.t: These two are matched in talent and beauty, and most likely they have fallen in love with each other."

units.source_text: 因此又是伤心，又是愤怒，又是嫉妒。

en.t: Because of this he was wounded, angry, and jealous all at once.

units.source_text: 他对二女公子总是放心不了，所以这一天不曾出门，写了两三封信送六条院去。

en.t: He could never feel at ease about the Second Princess, and so that day he did not go out, but wrote two or three letters and sent them to Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 几个老年侍女便私下讥议：“分别了才多久，积得这许多话！”

en.t: Several older ladies-in-waiting privately mocked him, saying, "How long has it been since they parted, for so many things to have piled up to say!"
